freshness_method: Guarded promotion must check exact target IDs against all canonical Urdu A1-B1 and live B2 sequences 1-12 immediately before append.

targets.intended_sense: respect, dignity, or protected moral standing
authorized or permitted to act or access information
need or requirement that may justify limited access or an exception
angle or perspective from which a problem is considered
humility; willingness to recognize the limits of one's own judgment
ashamed or embarrassed because of perceived wrongdoing or exposure
loyal or faithful to a person, group, or commitment
betrayal or serious breach of loyalty

generation_guardrails: B2 passage text remains in the 350-550 whitespace-token production band.
P1-P5 introduce exactly two new lexical targets each; P6 introduces none and visibly recycles all ten.
Difficulty comes from competing values, scope, exceptions, proportionality, accountability, and counterargument rather than vocabulary density.
Cases are fictional and do not give legal, medical, or individualized professional advice.
Ethical disagreements must present plausible competing considerations rather than partisan or moralistic caricatures.
Generation/integrity state remains separate from educator/publication release approval.
